sdxl.hook: wide misty river valley at dawn, a calm river winding down the middle, on the left bank a tall weathered memorial standing stone, on the right bank a second tall memorial standing stone facing it across the water, green hills, low mist on the river, empty and quiet, no people, no buildings, no flags
sdxl.arvel: a tall weathered memorial standing stone in the left foreground beside the charred black timber frames of a burned village, ash and empty doorways, grey morning, a wide river on the right side, on the far bank of the river many small stone cairns in a field, no people, no flags
